trial_title: Identification of Novel Biomarkers of Cervicovaginal Mucosal Inflammation
brief_summary: This study investigates the response of vaginal and cervical tissue after exposure to three vaginal products: hydroxyethyl cellulose (HEC) placebo, nonoxynol-9 (N9) and imiquimod (IMQ) cream.

eligibility_table.criterion: In good health, as evidenced by history and procedures at screening and enrollment visits without any clinically significant systemic disease
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of vaginal spotting and complicated UTIs, which may indicate underlying health issues.

eligibility_table.criterion: Not be at risk for pregnancy, due to surgical sterilization of participant and or her sexual partner, abstinence for duration of study, consistent condom use, non-hormonal IUD or same sex relationship. Note: If consistent condom user, must agree to use condoms without spermicide for duration of study.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has multiple male partners and inconsistent use of barrier contraceptives, indicating a risk for pregnancy.

eligibility_table.criterion: Have had regular menstrual cycles (every 24-35 days) for the past two cycles
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not had a menstrual period for 10 weeks, indicating irregular cycles.

eligibility_table.criterion: Willing and able to comply with study procedures
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not indicated any refusal to comply with study procedures.

eligibility_table.criterion: A clinically significant history of an abnormal pap smear (by written report) that has not been evaluated and or treated, if indicated, according to standard guidelines
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about the patient's pap smear history.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient had an abnormal pap smear in the past 5 years that has not been evaluated or treated according to standard guidelines?

eligibility_table.criterion: It has been less than 9 months since the participant's last depot medroxyprogesterone acetate (DMPA) injection and she has not had 2 normal, spontaneous menses (this can be shortened to 6 months if the participant has had at least 2 normal spontaneous menses)
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information regarding the patient's use of DMPA or menstrual history related to it.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient had 2 normal, spontaneous menses in the last 6 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Use of any other hormonal contraceptive method within past 3 months (oral, transdermal, transvaginal, implant, or intrauterine device) without 2 subsequent, normal menses
eligibility_table.justification: No information is provided about the use of hormonal contraceptives in the past 3 months.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient used any hormonal contraceptive method within the past 3 months without having 2 subsequent normal menstrual periods?

eligibility_table.criterion: Surgery or biopsy of the vulva, vagina, or cervix (including piercings) within 30 days
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information regarding any recent surgeries or biopsies.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone any surgery or biopsy of the vulva, vagina, or cervix within the last 30 days?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a serum β-hCG level indicating possible pregnancy, but no information on pregnancy history within the past 3 months.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient been pregnant within the last 3 months, specifically since the last menstrual period 10 weeks ago?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about whether the patient is currently breastfeeding.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently breastfeeding an infant aged 0-12 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Current STI or lower genital tract infection (including, but not limited to HIV-1, HSV-2, Chlamydia trachomatis (CT), Trichomonas vaginalis (TV), Neisseria gonorrhea (NG), Hepatitis B, high risk HPV sub types and or Syphilis), yeast vaginitis or bacterial vaginosis (BV)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of complicated UTIs, but no current STI or lower genital tract infection is documented. Further testing may be needed to confirm.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient tested positive for any sexually transmitted infections (STIs) or lower genital tract infections, including HIV-1, HSV-2, Chlamydia trachomatis, Trichomonas vaginalis, Neisseria gonorrhea, Hepatitis B, high-risk HPV subtypes, or Syphilis?

eligibility_table.criterion: Current use of chronic immunosuppressants (for example daily steroids or daily non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs [NSAIDs])
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not currently using any chronic immunosuppressants.

eligibility_table.criterion: Current presence of vulvar, anal and or vaginal genital warts
eligibility_table.justification: There is no mention of vulvar, anal, or vaginal genital warts in the patient's profile.

eligibility_table.criterion: Current tobacco use of any amount
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication of current tobacco use in the patient's profile.

eligibility_table.criterion: Other conditions that, in the opinion of the investigator, would constitute contraindications to participation in the study or would compromise the ability to comply with study protocols, such as any major chronic illness including but not limited to cancer, serious autoimmune disease, metabolic disorders or a major psychiatric disorder (e.g., schizophrenia)
eligibility_table.justification: While the patient has a history of complicated UTIs and other conditions, it is unclear if these would be considered major chronic illnesses that would exclude her from participation.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any major chronic illnesses, such as cancer, serious autoimmune disease, metabolic disorders, or a major psychiatric disorder, that would contraindicate participation in the study?

eligibility_table.criterion: Current participation in any other drug or device study, or any study which, in the opinion of the investigator, would compromise the ability to comply with study protocols
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication that the patient is currently participating in any other drug or device study.
